messages.subject: Difference in difference analysis
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to use lavaan to conduct difference in difference analysis. I am using this: 

model<- 'Rational =~ x1 + x2 + x3
Variable ~ time+ treatment+ treatment*time'

Is it possible to do that in lavaan? 

Bests, 
Betul

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Difference in difference analysis
parts: I would use the approach of "multiple group change score" model, that is equivalent to DID. But the regression form should work as well
